paracetamol.indications_summary: Used for mild to moderate pain and fever.
cautions: Do not exceed the maximum recommended daily dose.
Avoid other medicines containing paracetamol in the same day.
Use with caution if you have liver problems.
takeaways: Take the dose your doctor prescribed. Never exceed the maximum daily amount for paracetamol.
If fever or pain persists beyond the prescribed duration, consult your doctor.
diet_rules: Can be taken with or without food.
Avoid alcohol during treatment.

ibuprofen.indications_summary: Used for pain, inflammation and fever.
cautions: Take with food to protect the stomach.
Avoid if you have a stomach ulcer, asthma sensitive to NSAIDs, or severe kidney problems.
Avoid in the last trimester of pregnancy unless advised.
takeaways: Do not combine two types of NSAID medicines at the same time.
Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest time.
diet_rules: Take with food or milk.

takeaways: Finish the prescribed course even if you feel better.
diet_rules: Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after food.

metformin.indications_summary: Used to control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
cautions: Tell your doctor about any kidney problems.
Injectable contrast (CT scan) may require stopping it temporarily — ask your doctor.
takeaways: Take with food to reduce stomach upset.
Do not stop without talking to your doctor.
diet_rules: Take with or right after meals.
Avoid heavy alcohol intake.

omeprazole.indications_summary: Reduces stomach acid; used for acidity and reflux.
cautions: Tell your doctor about long-term use or if you take clopidogrel.
takeaways: Take at the same time each day.
Long-term use should be reviewed by a doctor.
diet_rules: Best taken before breakfast.

pantoprazole.indications_summary: Reduces stomach acid; used for acidity and reflux.
cautions: Long-term use should be reviewed by a doctor.
takeaways: Take once daily at the same time, preferably before a meal.
diet_rules: Best taken before breakfast.

amlodipine.category: calcium channel blocker; blood pressure medicine
amlodipine.indications_summary: Used to lower blood pressure and treat some chest pain.
cautions: Do not stop suddenly without medical advice.
Report persistent ankle swelling.
takeaways: Take at the same time each day.
Do not stop the medicine without your doctor.
diet_rules: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.

losartan.indications_summary: Used to lower blood pressure and protect the kidneys in some conditions.
cautions: Let your doctor know if you are pregnant.
Avoid potassium supplements without advice.
takeaways: Take at the same time each day.
Do not stop without your doctor.
diet_rules: Avoid large amounts of potassium supplements or salt substitutes without advice.

cautions: Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness.
Tell your doctor about grapefruit consumption.
takeaways: Take at the same time each day.
Sudden muscle pain with dark urine needs urgent medical attention.
diet_rules: Avoid drinking grapefruit juice during treatment.

levothyroxine.indications_summary: Replacement thyroid hormone for underactive thyroid.
common_side_effects: None at the correct dose; palpitations or sweating suggest a dose check is needed
cautions: Take on an empty stomach, at least 30-60 minutes before breakfast.
Skip doses only on medical advice.
takeaways: Take at the same time each day on an empty stomach.
Regular thyroid blood tests are needed.
diet_rules: Separate by at least 4 hours from iron, calcium and antacid medicines.

metronidazole.indications_summary: Used for certain bacterial and parasitic infections.
cautions: Do not drink alcohol during and for 48 hours after treatment.
Complete the full course.
takeaways: Avoid alcohol completely during treatment.
diet_rules: Avoid alcohol and alcohol-containing products during and 48 hours after treatment.

Report tendon pain, especially if you are over 60.
takeaways: Complete the full course.
diet_rules: Avoid milk or antacids within 2 hours of the dose.

cetirizine.indications_summary: Used for allergies such as hay fever and hives.
cautions: May cause drowsiness; use care when driving.
takeaways: Take the dose as prescribed; it works best when taken regularly.
diet_rules: Alcohol may increase drowsiness.

takeaways: Take before meals as directed.

ondansetron.indications_summary: Used to prevent nausea and vomiting.
cautions: Tell your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems.
takeaways: Take as directed; it is usually taken when needed.

rosuvastatin.indications_summary: Used to lower LDL cholesterol, total cholesterol and triglycerides, and to prevent cardiovascular events.
cautions: Report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness immediately.
Use with caution in liver disease or severe renal impairment.
takeaways: Take once daily at the same time each day, with or without food.
Do not stop taking without consulting your doctor.
diet_rules: Can be taken with or without food. Maintain a heart-healthy, low-cholesterol diet.

rabeprazole.indications_summary: Used for gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), acid peptic disorders, dyspepsia, and nausea/vomiting.
cautions: Best taken before food.
Inform doctor if symptoms do not improve.
takeaways: Take 30 minutes to 1 hour before breakfast or meals as prescribed.
diet_rules: Take on an empty stomach, 1/2 hour before food.

levocetirizine.indications_summary: Used for allergic rhinitis, cold/fever allergy symptoms, sneezing, itching, and hives.
cautions: May cause slight drowsiness; exercise caution when driving or operating machinery.
takeaways: Take as directed by doctor. Usually taken once daily in the evening or when required.
diet_rules: Can be taken with or without food.

prednisolone.indications_summary: Used for inflammation and immune conditions.
cautions: Do not stop suddenly after long use — taper with medical guidance.
Monitor blood sugar if diabetic.
takeaways: Take in the morning with breakfast where advised.
Do not stop suddenly.
diet_rules: Take with food.

cautions: Do not take extra doses on your own.
takeaways: Often taken once weekly as prescribed.
diet_rules: Take with a meal containing fat for better absorption.

ferrous_sulphate.indications_summary: Used to treat or prevent iron deficiency.
cautions: Keep away from children.
Stool may turn black — this is expected.
takeaways: Take as prescribed; there is no need for concern about dark stools.
diet_rules: Best taken on an empty stomach, or with food if it upsets your stomach.
Separate from tea, coffee, milk and calcium by at least 2 hours.

calcium.indications_summary: Used to maintain bone health when intake is insufficient.
cautions: Do not exceed the recommended dose.
takeaways: Take as directed; split doses may absorb better.
diet_rules: Separate from iron and thyroid medicine by at least 2 hours.

paracetamol.warfarin: Long-term regular paracetamol can increase the effect of warfarin; regular monitoring is advisable.
paracetamol.alcohol: Regular heavy alcohol intake increases the risk of liver damage with paracetamol.

ibuprofen.aspirin: Taking both ibuprofen and aspirin at the same time increases stomach-bleeding risk.
ibuprofen.anticoagulants: NSAIDs with anticoagulants (e.g. warfarin) increase bleeding risk.
ibuprofen.ace_inhibitors: NSAIDs can reduce the blood-pressure-lowering effect of ACE inhibitors.

metformin.alcohol: Heavy alcohol intake increases the risk of lactic acidosis.

levothyroxine.iron: Separate iron supplements from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours.
levothyroxine.calcium: Separate calcium supplements from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours.
levothyroxine.antacids: Separate antacids from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours.

ofloxacin.milk: Separate fluoroquinolone antibiotics from milk and antacids by about 2 hours.
ofloxacin.antacids: Separate fluoroquinolone antibiotics from milk and antacids by about 2 hours.

metronidazole.alcohol: Alcohol must be avoided during and 48 hours after metronidazole treatment.
